summary.intent: Integrate Neatlogs observability tracing across the multi-agent architectural pipeline and create the neatHack 2026 build log (hackathon.md).
summary.outcome: Added backend/aip/core/telemetry.py instrumenting WORKFLOW, AGENT, RETRIEVER, CHAIN, and LLM spans, verified live trace export and unit tests (tests/test_telemetry.py), and documented all milestones in hackathon.md.

repo: Keeping neatlogs_enabled=False in hermetic_settings preserves offline determinism for unit tests while enabling full OpenInference tracing in development and production.

code.finding: Provides context managers for WORKFLOW, AGENT, RETRIEVER, CHAIN, and LLM spans backed by the Neatlogs SDK.

workflow: Use InMemoryDiagnosticSpanExporter in tests/test_telemetry.py to assert span hierarchy without network calls.
